website.note: No dedicated /pipeline page; oncology and antivirals sections list preclinical programs only

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Both proprietary candidates (K1.1 mRNA-LNP for liver cancer and SBFM-PL4 small molecule PLpro inhibitor for SARS coronavirus) remain at preclinical/animal-testing stage. The 10-K explicitly states no IND or other regulatory filings have been made. Commercial revenue is from Nora Pharma generic distribution in Canada (~71 generic prescription drugs) plus Sunshine Canada OTC supplements.

commercial_product.description: Approximately 71 generic prescription drugs marketed in Canada via in-licensing, cross-licensing, and distribution agreements; OTC supplements (Essential.9, Calcium-Vitamin D, L-Citrulline, Taurine) via Sunshine Biopharma Canada Inc.

excluded_preclinical.stage: Animal testing; lead compound from University of Arizona license
